jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 건축인허가 주차장 lane `building-permit-parking` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0402): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_permit_parking already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows per 관리허가대장PK in buckets by the key's first two digits and append to main only the permits whose row changed and a removal marker per permit it no longer holds (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). One release per run; 2.84M rows, 43% of the 기본개요 lane (measured 6 min), well inside the 150-minute limit. Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.
